```{r, dev='png'}
# --- 3. Prepare input data ---

# Level 1: Conservative (3 errors -> rotate, 3 kills -> block)
# Level 2: Cautious (5 errors -> rotate, 5 kills -> block)
# Level 3: Default (10 errors -> rotate, 10 kills -> block)
# Level 4: Aggressive (20 errors -> rotate, 15 kills -> block)
# Level 5: Very Aggressive - Never Block (30 errors -> rotate, never block domain)
aggressiveness_level <- 5

# --- Optional Sleep Timer ---
# Set to NULL to disable.
# Set to a single number for a fixed delay in seconds (e.g., 0.5).
# Set to a vector of two numbers for a random delay within that range (e.g., c(0.2, 3)).
sleep_timer <- NULL # Example: random sleep between 0.5 and 2.5 seconds

# Show overview
overview_before_chunk_run <- func_11_generate_progress_report()

```

```{r}
# --- 5. Run Scraper ---
total_links <- nrow(chunk_dt)

message(sprintf("\nStarting to process %d links from chunk %s...", total_links, current_chunk))
message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))

if (total_links > 0) {
  for (i in 1:total_links) {
    link_info <- chunk_dt[i]
    
    message(sprintf("\n[%d/%d] Processing: %s", i, total_links, link_info$url))
    
    # --- The new, streamlined pipeline ---
    # MODIFIED: Pass the aggressiveness_level to the orchestrator.
    request_package <- func_04_prepare_request(
        id = link_info$id,
        url = link_info$url,
        domain = link_info$domain,
        chunk_dt = chunk_dt,
        aggressiveness_level = aggressiveness_level # Pass the configured level
    )
    
    if (request_package$success) {
      response_result <- func_05_execute_request(request_package = request_package, chunk_name = current_chunk, worker_id = 1)
      analysis_result <- func_07_analyze_response(response_result = response_result, chunk_name = current_chunk)
      
      final_action <- analysis_result$action
      message(sprintf("--> Status: %s (%s)", toupper(final_action), analysis_result$response_analysis))
      
    } else {
      message(sprintf("--> Status: SKIPPED (%s)", request_package$message))
    }
    
    # Check if all domains are exhausted to stop the chunk run early
    all_domains_in_chunk <- unique(chunk_dt$domain)
    current_states <- domain_tracker[domain %in% all_domains_in_chunk]
    
    # This logic now implicitly respects the kill_limit of the aggressiveness level
    if (all(current_states$session_kill_count >= 5 & aggressiveness_level < 5) || 
        (aggressiveness_level == 1 && all(current_states$session_kill_count >= 3))) {
        message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))
        message("All domains in the chunk are blocked. Terminating chunk run early.")
        message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))
        break
    }
    
    # --- Optional Sleep Timer ---
    if (!is.null(sleep_timer)) {
      if (length(sleep_timer) == 1 && is.numeric(sleep_timer)) {
        # Fixed sleep
        Sys.sleep(sleep_timer)
      } else if (length(sleep_timer) == 2 && is.numeric(sleep_timer)) {
        # Random sleep in range
        sleep_duration <- runif(1, min = sleep_timer[1], max = sleep_timer[2])
        Sys.sleep(sleep_duration)
      }
    }

    # --- CHECKPOINT-LOGIC ---
    if (i %% 1000 == 0 && i < total_links) {
        message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))
        message(sprintf("CHECKPOINT: Saving data after %d requests...", i))
        func_09_fill_output(current_chunk)
        message("CHECKPOINT: Emptying data structures.")
        func_09_init_data_structures(current_chunk)
        message("CHECKPOINT: Finished.")
        message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))
    }
  }
}

message(paste(rep("=", 70), collapse = ""))
message("CHUNK PROCESSING COMPLETE.")

```
